request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:CATAPULT

layers.text: Recolour only the bright light blue hide of the face, body, legs and tail to the frill's own deep blue, colour #205794 with #164271 shadows; and add three wide dark navy bands, colour #0f1a4a, across the back and one across the tail, each a fat solid band. Do not redraw anything. Keep the frill with its orange rim and two orange eye-spots, the cream horns, beak, studs and belly, the eyes, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
